messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx and timeouts from inference-gateway-prod observed by error-rate monitor. 1m error-rate = 18% (baseline 0.7%). Links: https://observability/redwood/incidents/4100001234
oncall-tim: I'm paged, jumping in. Can someone grab latest traffic heatmap?
sre-ana: grabbing charts now. initial look shows surge correlates with requests to /v1/generate for model 'rw-instruct-13b-quant' and high tail latency on <node-pool-gpu-3>.
eng-runtime-lead: noted. any recent deploys to inference runtime in the last hour?
sre-ana: no runtime deploys. config change: autoscaler bumped pool size ~30m ago due to sustained load.
oncall-tim: ok mark as P1. tagging @eng-runtime-lead and @pager. customer-impact: some multi-tenant customers seeing 5xx; CS reported error spikes for acme-payments and picnic-app.
customer-success-jess: acme-payments reports transaction webhook failures ~20% of calls. they want ETA.
eng-runtime-lead: can you paste kernel logs from one of the failing pods? suspect model runner crash or OOM.
sre-ana: pulling logs from node gpu-3-17 now. snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T18:22:41Z] runtime[pid=1245] ERROR: segfault at 0x7ffc... in quant_kernels.c:line 237
[2026-03-15T18:22:41Z] runtime[pid=1245] signal 11 (SIGSEGV) — dumped core
[2026-03-15T18:22:42Z] kubelet: evicting pod inference-runner-xyz due to OOMKill
```

oncall-tim: segfault + OOM sequence. are we seeing repeated restarts or growing page fault counts?
sre-ana: restarts per pod ~5 in last 10m. dmesg shows repeated GPU driver resets on same host. GPU watchdog kicked.
eng-runtime-lead: that aligns with a kernel-level segmentation in fused-quant path. trigger: high request token lengths from a small set of customers causing kv-cache blowout with quantized kernels.
oncall-tim: mitigation plan: 1) quick traffic routing to fallback model variant (rw-instruct-13b-fp16) 2) cordon and drain affected nodes 3) reduce per-request max_tokens to 512 via gateway rate-limit policy 4) increase eviction thresholds to avoid thrashing.
eng-runtime-lead: implementing fallback routing now. updating policy: 
```
PATCH /routing/policies/active
{"selector":"/v1/generate","priority":750,"route":"model:rw-instruct-13b-fp16","match":{"customer_id":["acme-payments","picnic-app"]}}
```
sre-ana: running drain script on gpu-3-17 and gpu-3-18: `./scripts/drain-node.sh gpu-3-17` — pods getting rescheduled.
observability-bot: :white_check_mark: routing policy applied. 5xx rate dropping to 9% in 2m. latency p95 still elevated.
customer-success-jess: telling acme-payments we have a mitigation and routing applied; they asked for timeline.
oncall-tim: ETA for full recovery estimate 45–60m assuming no new segfaults.
eng-runtime-lead: also pushing a conservative hotfix to disable fused-quant path for rw-instruct-13b-quant on prod pools. rolling to canary now. diff: `disable_option: fused_quant_kernel=true -> false`
sre-ana: canary looks stable for 3 nodes. no segfaults on canary for 10m.
observability-bot: 5xx now 1.8% cluster-wide. impacted customer 5xx for acme down from 22% to 2%.
oncall-tim: good. keep fallback routing for 1 hour, then we can progressively switch back after verification.
eng-runtime-lead: adding runbook note: if quant fused kernel causes segfaults, set env var `RW_DISABLE_FUSED_QUANT=1` and restart runners on a rolling basis, then monitor dmesg for driver resets.
sre-ana: creating incident ticket INC-20260315-4100001234 and linking logs + core dumps. saving core files to secure-bucket: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/4100001234/
customer-success-jess: notifying customers with brief timeline and apology. asking for any business-critical retry windows.
oncall-tim: handoff for next shift: @sre-ana you own monitoring until 23:00 UTC, @eng-runtime-lead to coordinate permanent rollback or kernel patch. include postmortem with root cause analysis.
sre-ana: ack. I'll keep hourly updates in this thread and attach follow-up analysis.
eng-runtime-lead: plan for next 24h: 1) revert fused-quant for prod; 2) add safeguard to enforce per-request kv-cache caps; 3) add a canary that probes long-token requests; 4) perf/regression tests for quant kernel.
oncall-tim: thanks everyone. closing active mitigations in 1h if stable. :thumbsup:
